title: ServerlessSplitStacksPlugin
description: Schema for the serverless-plugin-split-stacks (https://github.com/dougmoscrop/serverless-plugin-split-stacks). Splits a deployment into multiple nested CloudFormation stacks. Goes under `custom.splitStacks`.

nestedStackCount.description: Number of nested stacks to create when `perGroupFunction` is enabled. WARNING: should never be changed after initial deployment — changing it forces a full recreation.

perFunction.description: Split resources into a nested stack dedicated to each Lambda function.

perType.description: Move resources into a nested stack per resource type.

perGroupFunction.description: Split resources into a nested stack dedicated to a set of Lambda functions and associated resources.

stackConcurrency.description: How many nested stacks to deploy in parallel. Disabled when absent.

resourceConcurrency.description: How many resources to deploy in parallel. Disabled when absent.

custom.description: Path to a custom splitter module.

proxyAgent.description: Enable the proxy-agent library so HTTPS requests honour `HTTPS_PROXY` / `NO_PROXY` environment variables.
